subject: prd/self-drive-wake
statement: When a batch state request covers N proposals on a metered medium, the medium's adapter shall satisfy it in a number of API round trips bounded by a constant independent of N (within the medium's page size).
rationale: per-item reads are an unfixable N+1 on metered media (measured §2.4)
fit_criterion: the conformance kit asserts round-trip count: a 50-proposal batch on the GitHub adapter completes in ≤ 2 API calls
